analysis: New evidence is ordinary address-bounded LLVM objdump and PE byte/reference inspection, not newly returned REA dossiers or original execution. Hopper could not launch its local bridge (Connection is invalid); its retained180 evidence was exported, but cleanup acknowledgement was unavailable. No reinstall, external binary upload or Windows execution was attempted.

observations.fact: Non-T/U/C object operations obtain a coordinate record via0x732e60.
H applies the operand to the two-byte hint index at record offset1; it stores a string reference, not a frozen string copy.
Description read finds the coordinate record, reads its hint word, resolves the current z-index storage and expands it before copying to the512-byte destination buffer.
B calls record deletion0x732f50, not just a hint-word write.
Record deletion clears Used, hint word, all eight Disabled flags and the implemented-in-original automatic message slots.
D/E owner-1 resolves to the current source player, then writes the per-player disabled flag.

implementation: Coordinate hint references0..1000, including direct z operands, numeric setters, queries and H0.
Object access flags persist by coordinate across native deletion/recreation. Older ID-keyed saves retain a fallback and migrate on writes/removal.
B clears coordinate hint/access and any old ID-keyed mask on that object. UN:O flag1 deletes the record at its exact supplied coordinate.
Mobile inspection opens one persistent ordinary native message window, exposed through the existing scrollable HTML dialog. Desktop retains a right-click popup.
The original511 source character limit is adapted to511 UTF-8 codepoints to keep imported accented text intact.
limitations: External hint string tables above1000, HT/type and dynamic fallback records, hero hints, saturation of the original1000-record registry, hover-path parity and hints in fog are not fully ported or validated.
Only the coordinate access/hint fields implemented in this host are represented; original automatic message slots remain unported.
No original scenario quest, victory or carryover is established by these controls. Original campaigns and Cave remain disabled.
